payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information on how the dataset was collected, including the methodology, sources, speaker diversity, and quality assurance measures.

claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created using validated speech clips from the Common Voice corpus, which were recorded by contributors reading from a bank of donated sentences.
The dataset includes contributions from over 11,000 speakers across 11 languages, ensuring a diverse representation of accents and demographics.
Quality assurance measures included manual inspections of translations and checks for sentence length and perplexity to ensure high-quality data.
